sources.title: Aion 1.0: Microsoft's On-Device AI Models for Windows (2026)
sources.snippet: Microsoft announced the Aion 1.0 model family at Build 2026 — small AI models designed to run directly on Windows devices without cloud API calls. Two variants: Aion 1.0 Instruct (reasoning and instruction following) and Aion 1.0 Plan (planning, tool use, and agent workflows). sources.title: Aion 1.0 Plan - AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Aion 1.0 Plan is Microsoft's local agentic reasoning model for Windows. It is described as a 14B reasoning and tool-calling model with a 32K context length, designed to run locally on capable devices. Its purpose is to let applications reason over user intent, invoke tools, manage files, orchestrate sub-agents, and run agentic workflows without depending on cloud inference.
